assets.narrative: Echo-9 recovers a physical corporate authorization and simulation archive console from an already deceased executive; no killing by the protagonist is depicted. Its device authenticates rights and records, without controlling real alien biology.

generationBrief.composition: Wide single coherent landscape scene without overlays or titles: an olive-armoured helmeted Echo-9 examining a chunky amber CRT handheld in both gloved hands at an executive desk. Corporate badge and evidence pouch lie on the desk. An executive lies deceased without gore in a chair in shadow; through armoured glass, closed containment gates and cage transfer rails are visible. No combat or visible creature.
generationBrief.visualDirection: Restrained late-1970s/1980s retroindustrial space horror: cream worn equipment casings, browns, charcoal steel, green/amber CRT screens, padded walls, conduits, riveted bulkheads, practical lamp and low emergency lighting.
generationBrief.deviceConstraints: Mundane portable black/tan machinery with mechanical switches, removable authorization cartridges and a data connector; no floating holograms, neural controls or control beams.
generationBrief.paintingScope: Original scene using inspected project references as descriptive guidance; no source image was pixel-edited or passed as a target edit.
